title.zh: 将阿克兰省Kalibo市镇Dr. Rafael Tumbokon纪念医院床位由100张增至150张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Dr. Rafael Tumbokon Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Kalibo, Province of Aklan, From One Hundred (100) To One Hundred Fifty (150) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Dr. Rafael Tumbokon Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Kalibo, Province of Aklan, From One Hundred (100) To One Hundred Fifty (150) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Tưởng niệm Dr. Rafael Tumbokon tại Đô thị Kalibo, Tỉnh Aklan từ 100 lên 150 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Dr. Rafael Tumbokon ในเทศบาล Kalibo จังหวัด Aklan จาก 100 เป็น 150 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Memorial Dr. Rafael Tumbokon di Kotamadya Kalibo, Provinsi Aklan dari 100 menjadi 150 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Memorial Dr. Rafael Tumbokon di Perbandaran Kalibo, Wilayah Aklan daripada 100 kepada 150 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7589_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Dr. Rafael Tumbokon Memorial hospital in the Municipality of Kalibo, Province of Aklan, is hereby increased from one hundred (100) to one hundred fifty (150) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This act shall take effect upon its approval.
